CustomField.description: Where the unpaid portion of this request stands with the Managing Director. Driven by LeaveWithoutPayService: set to Pending MD Approval as soon as the balance falls short, and back to Not Required if the request is shortened so the balance covers it again. Only a user holding the Approve Leave Without Pay custom permission may move it to Approved or Rejected.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Approval state of the unpaid days. Only the Managing Director can approve or reject.
CustomField.label: LWOP Status
